$comment: Snowflake built-in functions (plan-batch3 WP-SF): the common scalar, semi-structured, date, aggregate, window, table, context and SYSTEM$ functions. Same shape as sqlite-functions.json; generated, edit freely.

functions.name: CEIL
functions.doc: Rounds X up to the given scale (default 0).

functions.name: FLOOR
functions.doc: Rounds X down to the given scale (default 0).

functions.name: ROUND
functions.doc: Rounds X to SCALE decimals ('HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO' or 'HALF_TO_EVEN').

functions.name: POWER
functions.doc: X raised to the power Y.

functions.name: DIV0
functions.doc: Division that returns 0 instead of an error when the divisor is 0.

functions.name: DIV0NULL
functions.doc: Division that returns 0 when the divisor is 0 or NULL.

functions.name: UNIFORM
functions.doc: Uniformly distributed number in [MIN, MAX] (GEN: RANDOM() for random values).

functions.name: UUID_STRING
functions.doc: A random (v4) or name-based (v5) UUID string.

functions.name: GREATEST
functions.doc: Largest argument (NULL if any is NULL).

functions.name: LEAST
functions.doc: Smallest argument (NULL if any is NULL).

functions.name: NVL2
functions.doc: NOT_NULL_VALUE when EXPR is not NULL, else NULL_VALUE.

functions.name: NULLIF
functions.doc: NULL when A = B, else A.

functions.name: IFF
functions.doc: Single-level IF: THEN_VALUE when CONDITION is true, else ELSE_VALUE.

functions.name: DECODE
functions.doc: Compares EXPR to each SEARCH and returns the matching RESULT (NULL matches NULL).

functions.name: CONCAT
functions.doc: Concatenates the arguments (NULL if any is NULL); also the

functions.name: INITCAP
functions.doc: Capitalises the first letter of each word.

functions.name: TRIM
functions.doc: Removes leading and trailing characters (default blanks).

functions.name: SPLIT_PART
functions.doc: The PART-th piece (negative counts from the end).

functions.name: POSITION
functions.doc: 1-based position of SUBSTR (0 when absent); also POSITION(a IN b).

functions.name: STARTSWITH
functions.doc: True when EXPR starts with PREFIX.

functions.name: ENDSWITH
functions.doc: True when EXPR ends with SUFFIX.

functions.name: RLIKE
functions.doc: Regular-expression match of the whole subject.

functions.name: REGEXP_LIKE
functions.doc: True when the whole SUBJECT matches PATTERN ('c' case-sensitive, 'i' insensitive, 'm', 's').

functions.name: TO_VARCHAR
functions.doc: Converts to text (with an optional format).

functions.name: TRY_TO_NUMBER
functions.doc: TO_NUMBER that returns NULL instead of an error.

functions.name: TRY_TO_DATE
functions.doc: TO_DATE that returns NULL instead of an error.

functions.name: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP
functions.doc: TO_TIMESTAMP that returns NULL instead of an error.

functions.name: TRY_CAST
functions.doc: CAST(… AS type) that returns NULL instead of an error.

functions.name: TO_OBJECT
functions.doc: Converts a VARIANT holding an object to OBJECT.

functions.name: TO_ARRAY
functions.doc: Wraps a value in an ARRAY (an ARRAY stays as is).

functions.name: PARSE_JSON
functions.doc: Parses JSON text into a VARIANT.

functions.name: TRY_PARSE_JSON
functions.doc: PARSE_JSON that returns NULL instead of an error.

functions.name: CHECK_JSON
functions.doc: NULL when EXPR is valid JSON, else the error.

functions.name: OBJECT_CONSTRUCT
functions.doc: Builds an OBJECT from key/value pairs (OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*) from a row); NULL values are left out.

functions.name: ARRAY_CONTAINS
functions.doc: True when the ARRAY contains VALUE.

functions.name: ARRAYS_OVERLAP
functions.doc: True when the ARRAYs share an element.

functions.name: GET
functions.doc: Element of an ARRAY by index or of an OBJECT by key (also v[0], v:key).

functions.name: GET_PATH
functions.doc: Value at a path ('a.b[0].c'); also the : operator.

functions.name: IS_NULL_VALUE
functions.doc: True for a JSON null (not SQL NULL).

functions.name: STRIP_NULL_VALUE
functions.doc: SQL NULL for a JSON null.

functions.name: AS_VARCHAR
functions.doc: The VARIANT as VARCHAR (NULL when it is not a string).

functions.name: AS_NUMBER
functions.doc: The VARIANT as NUMBER (NULL when it is not a number).

functions.name: CURRENT_AVAILABLE_ROLES
functions.doc: Roles the user may use (JSON array).

functions.name: CURRENT_WAREHOUSE
functions.doc: Warehouse of the session (NULL when none).

functions.name: CURRENT_TRANSACTION
functions.doc: Id of the open transaction (NULL when none).

functions.name: LAST_QUERY_ID
functions.doc: Query id of a previous statement of the session (-1 = the last one, 1 = the first).

functions.name: LAST_TRANSACTION
functions.doc: Id of the last transaction committed or rolled back.

functions.name: IS_ROLE_IN_SESSION
functions.doc: True when the role is active in the session (row access policies).

functions.name: DATEADD
functions.doc: Adds VALUE units of PART (year, month, day, hour, …).

functions.name: DATEDIFF
functions.doc: Number of PART boundaries between START and END.

functions.name: DATE_TRUNC
functions.doc: Truncates to the start of PART.

functions.name: LAST_DAY
functions.doc: Last day of the month (or PART).

functions.name: CONVERT_TIMEZONE
functions.doc: SOURCE_TZ VARCHAR, TARGET_TZ VARCHAR, EXPR TIMESTAMP_NTZ

functions.name: COUNT
functions.doc: Number of non-NULL values (COUNT(*) counts rows).

functions.name: COUNT_IF
functions.doc: Number of rows where CONDITION is true.

functions.name: BOOLAND_AGG
functions.doc: True when every value is true.

functions.name: BOOLOR_AGG
functions.doc: True when any value is true.

functions.name: LISTAGG
functions.doc: Concatenates the group's values; LISTAGG(x, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y).

functions.name: ARRAY_AGG
functions.doc: Collects values into an ARRAY; ARRAY_AGG(x) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y).

functions.name: OBJECT_AGG
functions.doc: Builds one OBJECT from key/value rows.

functions.name: MAX_BY
functions.doc: EXPR of the row with the largest BY.

functions.name: MIN_BY
functions.doc: EXPR of the row with the smallest BY.

functions.name: ROW_NUMBER
functions.doc: Row number within the window partition (often with QUALIFY).

functions.name: FIRST_VALUE
functions.doc: First value of the window frame.

functions.name: LAST_VALUE
functions.doc: Last value of the window frame.

functions.name: NTH_VALUE
functions.doc: N-th value of the window frame.

functions.name: CONDITIONAL_TRUE_EVENT
functions.doc: Window counter that increments when CONDITION is true (sessionisation).

functions.name: FLATTEN
functions.doc: Explodes an ARRAY/OBJECT into rows: SELECT f.value FROM t, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t.v) f.

functions.name: SPLIT_TO_TABLE
functions.doc: One row per piece of the string (SEQ, INDEX, VALUE).

functions.name: GENERATOR
functions.doc: Generates rows: SELECT SEQ4() FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 10)).

functions.name: RESULT_SCAN
functions.doc: Result of an earlier query: TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())).

functions.name: GET_QUERY_OPERATOR_STATS
functions.doc: Operator statistics of a completed query of the last 14 days.

functions.name: QUERY_HISTORY
functions.doc: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY: queries of the last 7 days (needs a warehouse).

functions.name: GET_DDL
functions.doc: DDL of an object ('TABLE', 'VIEW', 'FUNCTION', 'PROCEDURE' with argument types, 'SCHEMA', 'DATABASE', …).

functions.name: SYSTEM$CLUSTERING_INFORMATION
functions.doc: Clustering depth and overlap of a table (JSON).

functions.name: SYSTEM$EXPLAIN_PLAN_JSON
functions.doc: EXPLAIN plan of a statement as JSON.

functions.name: SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA
functions.doc: True when a stream has change records (task WHEN conditions).

functions.name: SYSTEM$TASK_DEPENDENTS_ENABLE
functions.doc: Resumes a task and all its dependents.

functions.name: TO_GEOGRAPHY
functions.doc: GEOGRAPHY from WKT, WKB or GeoJSON.

operators.doc: Lambda in higher-order functions: FILTER(arr, x -> x > 0)
